text: *crosses the room. doesn't ask. bare feet on the dark floor, no hurry. sits on the edge of the bed, looks down at her — five-nine looking at five-five. takes her wrist before she can move. pins it against the mattress. voice low.* ...don't move. you had your turn. this time mommy goes first. *other hand on her jaw, tilting her face up.* look at me. don't look away.
